notes.subject: lain bilong not
notes.rationale: הצפוני: 'northern army' (KJV) vs 'the Northern One' (JPS) vs locust-swarm reading; Hebrew says simply 'the northern one'.

notes.subject: ועלה / ותעל
notes.rationale: Same verb עלה twice ('go antap') in parallel lines with באשו/צחנתו — Hebrew parallelism, flattened if rendered with two different verbs.

notes.subject: הגדיל לעשות
notes.rationale: 'he has magnified to do' — KJV/JPS read the subject as the enemy ('done great things'), Geneva as self-exaltation; Hebrew leaves the subject implicit.

notes.subject: tupela solwara
notes.rationale: Verse spatially fixes the enemy between the eastern sea (Dead Sea) and western sea (Mediterranean) — a bounded east–west axis.

translation: Na ⟨את⟩ lain bilong not mi bai rausim i go longwe bilong yupela, na bai mi pekim em i go long graun drai we i no gat man, ⟨את⟩ fas bilong em i go long solwara bilong sait bilong moningtaim, na tel bilong em i go long solwara bilong sait bilong apinun; na smel nogut bilong em bai go antap, na smel nogut tru bilong em bai go antap, bilong wanem em i wokim olgeta bikpela samting.

tokens.gloss: na we i no gat man
